ux.text:
UX CONTEXT
TARGET: product
Specialty coffee subscription box helps coffee connoisseurs seeking variety discover new favorite specialty coffees.

ONBOARDING
1. Create your profile to get started.
2. Link your account to explore our selection.
3. Set up your preferences to receive personalized recommendations.

EMPTY STATE
1. You haven't added any coffees yet. Start exploring!
2. Your profile is incomplete. Finish setting it up!
3. No results found. Try adjusting your preferences!

ERROR
1. Oops! Your rating didn't save. Try again, and make sure you're logged in.
2. Sorry! The coffee you selected is out of stock. Choose another one instead.
3. Error: unable to process payment. Check your account settings and try again.

TOAST
1. Profile complete!
2. You've added a new coffee!
3. Results ready!

BUTTON LABELS
1. Rate This Brew
2. Add to Favorites
3. Explore More Coffees
4. Update My Preferences
5. View My Recommendations
6. Start a New Subscription
7. Edit My Profile Settings
8. Save My Coffee Notes
